Container.Name: TubeHaus-Web
Container.Overview:
Part 2 of 2, install TubeHaus too: this container is the web app you open in the browser, and it needs the TubeHaus server.
The TubeHaus web app: your own YouTube for the whole household, without ads or tracking. Open it in any browser, on a TV too. It routes to the TubeHaus server; install the TubeHaus template first and set its address below.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Open TubeHaus at http://[this server]:this port

Config.Name: Accounts
Config.Description: none: everyone shares one library. accounts: everyone signs up and gets their own (set the same on TubeHaus)
